title: Sébastien "deepnight" Benard - Mixing hand-crafted content with procgen to achieve quality
speaker: Sébastien "deepnight" Benard
talk_title: Mixing hand-crafted content with procgen to achieve quality
description: As I was working on Dead Cells back in 2018 at Motion Twin, we constantly tried to strike a balance between randomly generated content and handcrafted design to suit our very small team of 5 people back then. Now I'm doing the same thing for Tenjutsu, my new upcoming rogue, but this time I'm making a full open city all by myself. I will explain how I approached that and why!
